notes.title: Beta Update III
notes.content:
[h3]The Steamworks API has been integrated.[/h3]
The Steamworks API has been integrated and testers can start earning achievements and setting leaderboard records. We'll also spend time to include as many individual user stats as we can. This makes looking at your profile a little more prestigious, 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368144/b04dbb7f73f1fc60f66cc805fc82557894d8fe35.png[/img]
[i][b]How many achievements will there be?[/b][/i]
Right now there are 75 achievements (5 hidden/secret). We expect this will likely double once all the boats are in the game, especially with future content planned. Some achievements can not yet be earned as the levels or methods to do so are not yet available.

[i][b]How many leaderboards will there be?[/b][/i]
Each level will have an entire alphabet of wave patterns (26). We will start with recording the Fastest Lap (Best Time) on each level for each individual wave pattern. Then we will add additional leaderboards for; full race elapsed times, best times without crashing; times recorded while certain gameplay options are enabled, etc. [i]Certain gameplay options will disqualify you from posting to leaderboards.[/i]

[i][b]Will leaderboards get cleared?[/b][/i]
We have not yet determined if we will clear leaderboards on a schedule or have leaderboards that never get reset. Our players will let us know what's important and competitive.

[i][b]Can I reset my Steam® stats, achievements, and leaderboard times/scores in TBT?[/b][/i]
Yes. You will be able to both clear your local TBT profile and your online Steam® Stats, Achievements, and Leaderboard times/scores.

[i][b]I noticed an additional logo on the game's start screen, who is Illu Studio?[/b][/i]
Illu Studio has teamed up with us to improve the water materials, waves, foam and particle FX in TBT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368144/6a7d1053194e3c52ff4ea1c0fce4725c944b4e42.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368144/1e2d54ce687817a2569c4bf20213fda967293d65.png[/img]
[i][b]Where can I submit feedback?[/b][/i]
On the Steam® discussion boards or on our website [b][url=https://tunnelboatterror.com/feedback.html]here[/url][/b]. Thanks to everyone playing and sending us feedback. If you don't see your name in our credits under beta testing make sure to email us at [b][url=mailto:info@tunnelboatterror.com]info@tunnelboatterror.com[/url][/b]

notes.title: Demo Update II: Improved Physics & Controller Support
notes.content:
[h1]The TBT demo has been updated.[/h1]

The game has changed enough in the past 4 months that we felt the previous version would give future players the wrong impression.

In the months since the original demo was released we have been making the game more real with; updated player and AI physics, AI dock start and engine sounds, adding new levels to the game, creating additional wave patterns and water colors, fixing the menu system to work better with controllers and much much more. You can read all the things that got updated since the demo's release [url=https://tunnelboatterror.com/patch.html][b]here[/b][/url]. 

[b]We've been building new race and arcade situations for the game.[/b]
[previewyoutube=WWs9IpI-pMs;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=PtE3aLrshww;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=WYeVs8YcuC4;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Adding engine sounds to the AI to give the game some added depth.[/b][previewyoutube=ASH8jtJ9JRA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Refining the damage and consequence for rolling, flipping, encroaching the AI, and becoming airborne.[/b]
[previewyoutube=j09R1SaPFCE;full][/previewyoutube]
Thank you for the awesome community forming around TBT! Your feedback and support has driven us to push the limits of our development and design goals.

[i]New Demo Includes:[/i] [Size 6.03GB]
[b]Boats:[/b] Tunnel, Offshore (Early Example), Coast Guard (Early Example)
[b]Maps:[/b] [16 Lake Wave Patterns A – O, Glass]
(1) Developer Test Tank, (1) Drag [1, ½ , ¼ Mile], (1) Circuit; The Bridge (2) Arcade; Mangroves, Hurricane Hustle, Garage (Visual Preview), Showroom (Visual Preview)
[b]Features:[/b] Game Options; Video, Audio, Gameplay, Controls, Key Rebinding, Credits, Custom Paintjobs, 8k Photo Mode, Local Achievements, Music Control (67 Racing / 16 Menu Music Tracks), Profile Loading/Saving/Deletion, Lap Count, Name Registration, Wind, Destruction/Damage, Tunnel Vision, 4-15 AI Opponents, Rearview Mirrors, Radar, Cockpit Camera, Chase Camera, Cinematic Cameras, Main Menu, Pause Menu & Improvements for Controllers

notes.title: Beta Update II
notes.content:
[h3]If you have a beta key you can now test the latest changes to the game. You can read the full patch notes here: [url=https://tunnelboatterror.com/patch.html][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/url][/h3]

Since the release of the demo our time was spent; rebuilding the main menu to work fully with controllers, adding options for audio, gameplay, and controls, updating the individual boats and elements like the buoys with the new physics, bringing additional boats into the game, as well as doing some level design.

- The Garage was optimized to run faster and had its lighting improved.
- The Showroom was optimized to run faster and had its lighting improved.
- The Tunnel Boat is getting really close, but we still feel it needs more work.
- New boats will start to get a lot more attention, including a take down ability for the Coast Guard.
- The collisions for things like landscapes have been improved.
- The menu system was rebuilt to work better with controllers.
- Additional options for; Audio, Gameplay, Controls, & Customizing Inputs was added.

[i][b]Why does the current beta have less content then the demo?[/b][/i]
We use our beta (or actual game build on Steam) as our public test platform. Our fans and testers need to play the latest content in order to provide feedback as we progress with the development. Right now our focus is to put the finishing touches on the Tunnel Boat.

[i][b]Why is the tutorial greyed out in the menu?[/b][/i]
We are reworking the tutorial levels to include the latest changes to the game.

[i][b]Why doesn't the boat fully flip over?[/b][/i]
We are working on the random flightiness of the boat when it reaches that threshold of instability, as well as the consequence (damage) for rolling or flipping.

[i][b]Quick events seem broken.. I can't possibly win?[/b][/i]
We are still refining the speed and acceleration of the player and AI.

[i][b]What do I do in the showroom and garage?[/b][/i]
Nothing but admire the view for just a little while longer. :) We are integrating the Steam API to be used in the Showroom and working on the Garage customization UI. Soon enough these areas will have working utility.

[i][b]Where can I submit feedback?[/b][/i]
On the Steam discussion boards or on our website here: [b][url=https://tunnelboatterror.com/feedback.html]FEEDBACK[/url][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368144/b2d743e0de826ab55661ffab01ce3360aa36ca84.png[/img]

The game will be updated frequently as we make additional changes. Thank you to all of our testers for playing and submitting feedback.

If you don't see your name in our credits under beta testing, make sure to email us at [b][url=mailto:info@tunnelboatterror.com]info@tunnelboatterror.com[/url][/b]

notes.title: Beta Updated
notes.content:
[h3]If you have a beta key you can now test the latest changes to the game, including the new physics updates and the Offshore boat.[/h3]

[i][b]Why does the current beta have less content then the demo?[/b][/i]
We use our beta (or actual game build on Steam) as our public test platform. Our fans and testers need to play the latest content in order to provide feedback as we progress with the development. Right now our focus is to balance the Tunnel Boat inside the TEST TANK before adding Trim back into the system.

[i][b]Why isn't the Trim working?[/b][/i]
We are currently modifying the Trim to be more realistic/effective and respond to the new physics updates. This should be available in the coming days.

[i][b]Why isn't the Test Menu working for the Offshore boat?[/b][/i]
We are still working on functional things within the Offshore boat, this should be available in the coming weeks. 

[i][b]Where can I submit feedback?[/b][/i]
On the Steam discussion boards or on our website here: [b][url=https://tunnelboatterror.com/feedback.html]FEEDBACK[/url][/b]

[i][b]Why does the Tunnel Boat keep diving underwater?[/b][/i]
We have intentionally left some of the drag and lift variables default so you can play with them yourself. By adjusting settings under HULL, WATER, or AIR you can prevent that from happening.

[i][b]Quick events seem broken.. I can't possibly win?[/b][/i]
In the coming days the WATER variables will get carried over to the quick events and the AI will be updated, this will fix these events. The quick races were left in so you could test crashing, FPS w/ 15 AI in the level, as well as other things like how the camera affects the way driving feels in those maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368144/0f4c3b9c6c30fef73b3d7602e7a07812cfa79b69.png[/img]

We'll be updating the game quite frequently as feedback roles in and we make additional changes. Thank you to all of our beta testers and welcome to all the new testers that have joined us since the Steam® NeXT Fest.

If you don't see your name in our credits under beta testing, make sure to email us at [b][url=mailto:info@tunnelboatterror.com]info@tunnelboatterror.com[/url][/b]

notes.title: Demo Updated: Respawn Ability
notes.content:
[h1]The Demo has been updated.[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added respawning ability during circuit races.
[*] Added One Button Start. Enabled One Button Start in the Gameplay Options by default
[*] Disabled AI Wake Turbulence in the Gameplay Options by default.
[*] Fixed benchmark test.
[*] Fixed previous known issue. Engine Sound After Crashing or using the Killswitch.
[/list]
Now, instead of being totally destroyed after crashing and the race ending, the boat will revert back to the crash area and the sponsons (or decks) of the boat will return to their original state. Each sponson side (port and starboard) can be damaged (3) times before the race is ended. After (3) crashes on a single side, the race will restart. We will make the number of crashes in order to be disqualified an adjustable option for the player in the future. This should be a more familiar approach to racing for your average gamer and reduce frustration.

One button start has been added and turned on by default. It can be turned off by the player in the gameplay options menu. Instead of having to use the fuel pump + ignition, players now only have to use the ignition button.

At the start of the circuit race with all the AI wakes happening, the screen would jitter as the AI wake effect needs to be toned down. It has been disabled by default but can be enabled at anytime. This will be re-enabled by default once improved.

Benchmark test was not firing. This has been fixed. Game should now automatically adjust visual settings based on your hardware the first time you run the game.

After rolling, flipping, or using the Killswitch, when the player restarted the engine, the player had to let go of the Throttle or the engine sound would fade away.

[b]If you want to delete your local achievements, registered driver name, graphics or gameplay options, save file, etc you can navigate to this folder and delete it or delete your profile in game.[/b]

notes.title: Demo is LIVE on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]The TBT playable demo is now live.[/h1]
[h3]"Building this game has been on my mind for over 15 years, now it's here!"[/h3]

After three years of hard work I'm happy to finally let people test Tunnel Boat Terror and start helping me bring it across the finish line. Play the game and let me know what you think by using the [b]FEEDBACK[/b] button in the game menu.

[h2]LOVE IT? HATE IT? WE WANT TO KNOW![/h2]
Good or bad, we want to hear what you think. Our progress, and the future success of TBT, is all thanks to really cool players like yourself who've chimed in along the way and provided their genuine, honest, and passionate feedback. TBT was developed and produced by a single independent developer and will only get better with your help and support!
